final_truth: The Brandenburg Concertos, composed by Johann Sebastian Bach for Duke Johann von Brandenburg, are six masterworks for instruments and voice. Composed in 1725, they remain a cornerstone of the Baroque repertoire, showcasing Bach’s genius for counterpoint and orchestration. This set of concertos, dedicated to the Margrave of Brandenburg, represents one of the most influential collections in the history of Western music.
